title: sealedSessions
responsibility: Projects authenticated publisher envelopes into Home session status and ordered transcript text.

inputs.name: sealedSessions.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: sealedSessions.objects
inputs.description: Scope objects with their exact server ciphertext and opaque object IDs.

inputs.name: sealedSessions.keys
inputs.description: Non-extractable browser scope keys or the resolver for keys by envelope epoch.

outputs.name: sealedSessions
outputs.description: Session rows assembled from authenticated status objects and ordered transcript segments.
